description: Electricity Consumption, Borough is a dataset listed in London Datastore, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). Electricity consumption by sector. Data for Middle Super Output Areas (MSOA) also available. Department for Environment and Climate Change are carrying out further analysis of the consistency between the 2008 sub-national data and the 2008 data published at UK level in the Digest of UK energy statistics; at this stage we recommend that users consider ... Coverage: Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). The publisher named on the listing is Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy (BEIS). Its keywords include consumption, electricity, resources, energy. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence v2. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-london-datastore.
